note.en: Dhanvantari emerges from the churned ocean of milk bearing the kalasha (cup/vessel) of Amrita

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Book I, Chapter IX ("Dhanwantari, robed in white, and bearing in his hand the cup of Amrita, next came forth")

note.en: After the Daityas seize the Amrita-kalasha from Dhanvantari, Vishnu assumes the Mohini form to recover it and deliver it to the gods

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Book I, Chapter IX ("the Daityas...took away the Amrita...Vishnu, by his delusive power, assumed the form of a female...and beguiled the Daityas of the beverage")
